info.title: Learner API
info.description: API for retrieving learner data with support for batch processing.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of learners. Supports optional filtering by a 'sinceTime' parameter to fetch learners modified since the given timestamp.

parameters.name: sinceTime
parameters.description: Optional timestamp filter to return learners updated since this time.

parameters.name: batch_number
parameters.description: The batch number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: The maximum number of learners to return in a single batch. Defaults to 1000.

401.description: Unauthorized. The request requires user authentication.

BatchNumber.description: The batch number of the learners being returned.

BatchSize.description: The total number of learners returned in this batch.

TotalNumberOfBatches.description: The total number of batches available.

Learners.description: The list of learners in the current batch.

ApprenticeshipId.description: The unique identifier for the apprenticeship.

TrainingCode.description: The code of the training course the learner is enrolled in.

TrainingCourseVersion.description: The version of the training course.

TrainingCourseVersionConfirmed.description: Indicates whether the training course version has been confirmed.

TrainingCourseOption.description: The option of the training course if applicable.

StandardUId.description: The unique identifier for the training standard.

StartDate.description: The start date of the apprenticeship.

EndDate.description: The end date of the apprenticeship.

CreatedOn.description: The date when the learner record was created.

UpdatedOn.description: The date when the learner record was last updated.

StopDate.description: The date when the apprenticeship was stopped if applicable.

PauseDate.description: The date when the apprenticeship was paused if applicable.

CompletionDate.description: The date when the apprenticeship was completed if applicable.

UKPRN.description: The UK provider reference number associated with the apprenticeship.

LearnRefNumber.description: The reference number of the learner.

EmployerAccountId.description: The employer's account ID associated with the apprenticeship.

EmployerName.description: The name of the employer associated with the apprenticeship.

PaymentStatus.description: The payment status of the apprenticeship, corresponding to predefined statuses.
